item.title: Bears Hall of Famer Steve McMichael's widow, Misty, arrested
item.description: <p>Misty McMichael, who was part of the successful lobbying effort for her husband Steve’s inclusion into the Pro Football Hall of Fame before his death in April 2025, was arrested Friday and charged with domestic battery.</p><p>Will County sheriff's deputies arrested McMichael, 55, at a Frankfort home, where she was accused by an unnamed man of arguing for hours and choking him. item.title: 2 hospitalized in East Garfield Park apartment fire
item.description: <p>Two people were hospitalized after an apartment fire Saturday evening in East Garfield Park on the West Side. </p><p>The two-alarm fire broke out sometime before 6:30 p.m. in the 3400 block of West Madison Street, according to the Chicago Fire Department. </p><p>Two people were taken to area hospitals with unspecified injuries, fire officials said. </p><p>There were about 20 residents displaced due to the fire, according to Chicago police scanner audio. </p><p>The cause of the fire wasn’t imm

item.title: Woman killed in Far South Side drive-by shooting
item.description: <p>A woman was killed and another wounded in an East Side neighborhood drive-by shooting early Saturday on the Far South Side.</p><p>Just after 1 a.m., both women, ages 29 and 37, were in a crowd gathered in a parking lot in the 10200 block of South Avenue J when someone opened fire from a passing blue vehicle, according to a statement from Chicago police.</p><p>The older woman was hit in the leg and the younger in the chest.
